description: AIVI is a fashion shopping assistant for UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, and Oman. Users can browse broad categories with diversified themed groups, search with specific filters (brand, color, size, price), look up detailed product attributes for items already shown, and get authoritative answers to customer-service questions and shipping or return policies - all through natural conversation in ChatGPT.

defaultPrompt: Date night is loading... I need a look I'll actually love
My taste? Authentic only... show me the real deal.
